cens.translation: abbr. censor （书刊、邮电等的）审查员; 检查员; censorship （书刊、邮电等的）审查; census 人口普查

cense.definition: v. perfume especially with a censer
cense.translation: vt. 焚香, 用香熏, 焚香致敬

censed.translation: v. 焚香, 用香熏, （作为宗教仪式）燃香( cense的过去式和过去分词 )

censer.definition: n. a container for burning incense (especially one that is swung on a chain in a religious ritual)

censers.definition:
plural of censer
n. a container for burning incense (especially one that is swung on a chain in a religious ritual)

censes.definition: v perfume especially with a censer
censes.translation: vt. 焚香, 用香熏, （作为宗教仪式）燃香（cense的第三人称单数形式）

censing.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Cense
censing.translation: v. 焚香, 用香熏, （作为宗教仪式）燃香( cense的现在分词 )

censor.definition:
n. someone who censures or condemns
n. a person who is authorized to read publications or correspondence or to watch theatrical performances and suppress in whole or in part anything considered obscene or politically unacceptable
v. subject to political, religious, or moral censorship
censor.translation:
n. 检查员
vt. 检查, 审查, 删改

censorable.translation: a. 须受检查的, 可诟病的

censored.definition: a. suppressed or subject to censorship
censored.translation:
a. 受审查的, 被删剪的
v. 删剪（书籍、电影等中被认为犯忌、违反道德或政治上危险的内容）( censor的过去式和过去分词 )

censorial.definition: a. belonging or relating to a censor or a censor's functions
censorial.translation:
a. 检查官的, 苛评的
[法] 监察官的, 检查官的, 非难的

censoring.definition:
n. counterintelligence achieved by banning or deleting any information of value to the enemy
n. deleting parts of publications or correspondence or theatrical performances
censoring.translation: v. 删剪（书籍、电影等中被认为犯忌、违反道德或政治上危险的内容）( censor的现在分词 )

censorious.definition: s. harshly critical or expressing censure
censorious.translation: a. 爱批判的, 挑剔的

censors.definition:
n someone who censures or condemns
n a person who is authorized to read publications or correspondence or to watch theatrical performances and suppress in whole or in part anything considered obscene or politically unacceptable
v forbid the public distribution of ( a movie or a newspaper)
v subject to political, religious, or moral censorship
censors.translation: v. 删剪（书籍、电影等中被认为犯忌、违反道德或政治上危险的内容）( censor的第三人称单数 )

censorship.definition:
n counterintelligence achieved by banning or deleting any information of value to the enemy
n deleting parts of publications or correspondence or theatrical performances
censorship.translation:
n. 检查制度
[医] 督察, 监察

censorship of press.translation: [法] 出版物的审查, 新闻检查

censual.definition: a. Relating to, or containing, a census.

censur.translation: [医] 督察员, 监察员, 潜意识的抑制(精神分析)

censurable.definition: s deserving blame or censure as being wrong or evil or injurious
censurable.translation: a. 可非难的, 该责备的

censure.translation:
n. 责难
vt. 非难, 指责

censured.translation: v. 指责, 非难, 谴责( censure的过去式 )

censurer.translation: 谴责别人的人（censure的变体）; 指责别人的人（censure的变体）

censures.definition:
n harsh criticism or disapproval
n the state of being excommunicated
v rebuke formally
censures.translation: v. 指责, 非难, 谴责( censure的第三人称单数 )

censuring.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Censure
censuring.translation: v. 指责, 非难, 谴责( censure的现在分词 )

census.definition:
n. a periodic count of the population
v. conduct a census
census.translation:
n. 户口普查
vt. 实施统计调查

census bureau.translation: 人口统计局，人口调查局；人口普查局

census data.translation:
户口普查资料
[法] 人口调查资料

censuses.definition:
n. a periodic count of the population
v. conduct a census
censuses.translation: n. 人口普查, 统计( census的复数形式 )
